content:
**Radtoad Omelette** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A Radtoad Egg that has been cooked into an omelet over a fire. It gives a 30 minute boost to Endurance while restoring a moderate amount of HP and hunger at the cost of a moderate dose of rads.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Radtoad Egg (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Radtoad Egg | | Radtoad Omelette (1) | 

It can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after having picked up a Radtoad Egg for the first time.

The spelling is that of British English. "Omelet" is the American English spelling. [1]
